_note: In-engine ARRIVAL CUTSCENE (no pre-rendered video): the new transfer is dropped off at the school gates and met by a faculty member, then it hands straight off to day_one. Built entirely from data-driven primitives -- `camera` (scripted cutscene framings, blended cuts), `letterbox` (cinematic bars), `say` (one dialogue line at a time, speaker + text), plus `banner`, `spawn_enemy` (repurposed as a silent, non-hostile faculty stand-in that walks up -- there is no dedicated friendly-NPC/dialogue system yet) and `fade`. Each beat is its own timer-paced stage so the lines/shots read in order; the stage machine advances on the timer with no player input, so it also runs clean under the headless smoke harness (-BRMissionSmoke=arrival). ALL dialogue is our own wording, no lines from any script; characters are original (no Jimmy likeness). The player starts at the day_one drop-off spot [29836,7223,700] yaw 180 (facing the courtyard); the faculty stand-in spawns a few metres ahead (toward -X). Camera positions/look targets are first-pass framings in UE cm -- headless logs confirm the cuts fire and the view target blends, but the actual composition wants a rendered play pass. on_complete releases the cutscene camera, fades to black, and chains into day_one (the end-card is auto-suppressed for chained missions).
title: Arrival

on_start.speaker: Guardian
on_start.text: This is it. End of the drive. Out you get.

on_start.speaker: Guardian
on_start.text: The last school didn't want you back. Don't go making a habit of it.

on_start.speaker: Prefect
on_start.text: So you're the new transfer. Stand up straight when I'm speaking to you.

on_start.speaker: Prefect
on_start.text: Head down, hands to yourself, do as you're told. Trouble finds boys like you quick enough on its own.

on_start.speaker: Prefect
on_start.text: The Headmaster's waiting. Through the gates -- and don't dawdle.
